title: StructEval: Deepen and Broaden Large Language Model Assessment via Structured Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a structured evaluation framework for LLMs based on pedagogical theories (Bloom's Taxonomy) and concept mapping. The evaluation focuses on factual knowledge and cognitive processing (e.g., apple cultivars, medical facts like the facial nerve, science questions). It does not have a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
